title: thymus serpyllum f. transsilvanicus
intro: Thymus serpyllum f. transsilvanicus, commonly known as Wild Thyme, is a subspecies of the Thymus serpyllum plant, native to the Transylvanian region of Romania. It is a perennial herb that has been used for centuries in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Wild Thyme include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote a restful sleep. The bioactive constituents of Wild Thyme include thymol, carvacrol, and rosmarinic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
